h1: Custom 1 oz Lotion for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 1 oz lotion in bulk for giveaways, travel, and events. Perfect for branding on the go. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 1 oz lotion is a smart choice for businesses that want to offer a practical, travel-friendly giveaway. At this size, your logo fits neatly on a compact bottle that recipients can toss in a purse, gym bag, or carry-on. Unlike larger sizes, 1 oz lotion is ideal for event swag bags, hotel amenities, or corporate care packages where convenience matters. Decorate with a foil stamp or screen print for a polished look that keeps your brand top of mind with every use.
heroAltText: Custom 1 oz lotion bottles with white lotion and a blue label, perfect for travel-sized promotional giveaways.
